insights.title: Keyword cannibalization: 27 open consolidation groups
insights.body: Groups of live pages competing for the same primary term. Severity is computed from how many are genuinely still live after verified redirects. Worst offenders on the Sep 2 data: 721 exchange (6 URLs, three of them still naming "721 exchange" (1,900/mo) as their top keyword, best position still 38), REIT definition (7 still live; /what-is-a-reit-and-how-does-it-work/ ranks 69 for "reit" 40,500/mo while /everything-you-need-to-know-about-reits/ ranks 65 for "reits" 33,100/mo — the split is now measurable head-to-head), senior housing (8 assets, of which 5 now rank for nothing at all).

insights.title: Clusters with no pillar page: Opportunity Zones
insights.body: Opportunity Zones has no pillar (you re-tiered /education-center/qofs-vs-dsts/ to fan-out; a QOF-basics pillar was marked TO BE CREATED in your sheet). A cluster without a pillar has nothing for its fan-out pages to link up to.

insights.title: 3 URLs return 404
insights.body: /private-credit-funds/ (a former offering page — Bridge/Private-Credit transactional), /preserve-1031-exchanges/ and /what-exactly-are-opportunity-zone-rules/ returned hard 404s in the Aug 23 crawl. NOT re-verified on Sep 2 — no browser was available in this run. None of the three appears in the fresh SEMrush pull, which is consistent with them still being gone but is not proof either way. If these were retired deliberately they should 301 to their nearest replacement instead of 404ing; /private-credit-funds/ especially, since offering pages accumulate links.

insights.title: 47 redirecting URLs are still advertised in the sitemap
insights.body: As of the Aug 23 crawl, sitemap_index.xml children still listed 47 URLs that 301 elsewhere. A sitemap should only advertise canonical, 200-status URLs — this wastes crawl budget and re-announces retired pages. The three 404s above should also be pruned if present. NOT re-checked on Sep 2 (no browser in this run) — if the sitemap has been cleaned since, this count is stale.

insights.title: 22 redirects point at listing pages (soft-404 pattern)
insights.body: Redirects into /category/news/, /education-center/blog/, the glossary hub or the homepage pass no topical relevance and are usually treated as soft-404s by Google. Fine for true retirements; a loss for anything that had links or rankings.

insights.title: 38 slug-update candidates
insights.body: Live URLs whose slug is missing its own primary keyword, carries a WordPress "-2"/"part-N" suffix, or is marketing filler. Each entry carries a suggested slug; ship with a 301. Still open from Aug 23: /https-www-youtube-com-1031crowdfunding/ — a raw YouTube URL as a slug, live and indexed. Note /drop-and-swap-the-basics/, whose suggested slug is /drop-and-swap-1031-exchange/: the Sep 2 SEMrush pull shows BOTH URLs carrying keywords, so the new page appears to have shipped while the old one is still live. A crawl needs to confirm the 301.

insights.title: Uneven series cleanups
insights.body: Multi-part series where some parts were redirected and others left live: understanding-dst series — parts 1 & 3 redirect to the DST hub; part 2 redirects too (verified Aug 23) — resolved. · 10-reasons DST series — part 1 redirects to /delaware-statutory-trust-pros-and-cons/ but part 2 is still live with a "-part-2" slug. · comparing-investment-valuation-tools series — part 1 redirects to the blog listing; parts 2 and 3 are still live. Merge into one metrics explainer.

insights.title: 175 live pages rank for nothing
insights.body: The Sep 2 pull reached every ranking URL, so these are measured zeros, not missing data: 175 of the 389 live pages hold no keyword anywhere in Google's top 100. Previous builds could not tell "no data yet" apart from "no rankings" — now they can. The bulk are press/news posts and off-topic company pieces, but the list also includes pages you have tiered as pillars, which is the part worth acting on.

insights.title: Author archives and /tag/video/ are indexable and in the sitemap
insights.body: 4 author pages and a tag archive are index,follow and sitemap-listed. Thin archive pages rarely earn rankings; consider noindex or removing them from the sitemap.

insights.title: Meta robots: zero noindexed pages, zero canonical mismatches (Aug 23)
insights.body: On Aug 23 every one of the 389 live pages was fetched and its <meta name=robots> and rel=canonical checked: all index,follow with self-referencing canonicals, and robots.txt blocking only search/query paths (plus privacy/security/terms). NOT re-verified on Sep 2 — this run had no browser, so nothing published or changed in the last 10 days has been checked.

insights.title: SEMrush units: fresh data pulled Sep 2, then the balance hit zero again
insights.body: Good news first: the balance had been topped up, so this refresh pulled the full pages report plus roughly 4,000 keyword rows — every metric on this board is Sep 2 data, the first fresh pull since Aug 18. The balance then ran out mid-run, which is why 15 low-volume pages show a keyword count but no top keyword. It will need another top-up before next Monday's refresh.
